questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank in the given sentence.**

Will someone please help me lift ______ heavy box?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'this'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us explore the given options:

 
 
• The word 'them' will act as a pronoun in the sentence and is used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to two or more people or things previously mentioned or easily identified. 
 
• The word 'these' will act as a plural determiner in the sentence and is used to specify the near persons or things we are talking about.
 
• The word 'those' will act as a plural determiner in the sentence and is used to specify the far persons or things we are talking about.
 
• The word 'this' will act as a singular determiner in the sentence and is used to specify the near persons or things we are talking about.
 
 
• In the given sentence, 'this' should be used to identify the specific thing (heavy box).

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Complete Sentence: *Will someone please help me lift this heavy box?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• We use “this”, “that”, “these” and “those” to specify which person(s) or thing(s) we are talking about.
 
• They are used immediately before the noun (here, box) they are referring to.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f1d776c4ca45212685ca0930c2539d73a1d70923a3eebad6480bea0298a95b3.png] 

 
• आइए दिए गए विकल्पों का पता लगाएं:

 
 
• शब्द 'them' वाक्य में एक pronoun के रूप में कार्य करेगा और दो या दो से अधिक लोगों या चीजों को पहले उल्लेखित या आसानी से पहचाने जाने के लिए verb या preposition की वस्तु के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है।
 
• शब्द 'these' वाक्य में एक बहुवचन determiner के रूप में कार्य करेगा और इसका उपयोग उन निकट व्यक्तियों या चीजों को निर्दिष्ट करने के लिए किया जाता है जिनके बारे में हम बात कर रहे हैं।
 
• 'Those' शब्द वाक्य में एक बहुवचन determiner के रूप में कार्य करेगा और दूर के व्यक्तियों या चीजों को निर्दिष्ट करने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जिनके बारे में हम बात कर रहे हैं।
 
• शब्द 'this' वाक्य में एक विलक्षण determiner के रूप में कार्य करेगा और इसका उपयोग उन निकट व्यक्तियों या चीजों को निर्दिष्ट करने के लिए किया जाता है जिनके बारे में हम बात कर रहे हैं।
 
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में, 'this' का प्रयोग विशिष्ट वस्तु (heavy box) की पहचान के लिए किया जाना चाहिए।
 
 
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है ।

पूरा वाक्य: *Will someone please help me lift this heavy box?*

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

I am learning a new language this year.

options.text: A new language is being learnt by me this year.
A new language has been learnt by me this year.
A new language was being learnt by me this year.
A new language is going to be learnt by me this year.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**A new language is being learnt by me this year**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64e177b3c5c5cb81c12b3d5b5ddabaaf474cdad3d6098992ca6592786c8147d6.png] 

 
• In **Active Voice**, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In **Passive Voice**, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The **given sentence** is in the **active voice** and **'I'** is the **subject **and '**a new language**' is the **object**.
 
• When we convert this sentence into **passive voice**, the **subject 'I'** of the active voice **becomes **the **object 'me'**, the **object 'a new language' becomes** the **subject**.
 
• The passive format "**'is + being + V3 (learnt)"** should be used.
 
• This is the active and passive voice **rule **for the **present continuous tense.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1*.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87c1a28e731fadd9279228c1cea2f8e988a3f790bf9ccc89c9b0f02c423b1609.png]

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words.**

A large bedroom for a number of people in a school or institution
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Dormitory'.

***__Key Points__**

 
• Let us explore the given options:-

 
 
• 'Mansion' is **a large, impressive house**.

 
 
• **Example:** *His new luxury **mansion** was a world away from the tiny house where he was born*.
 
 
 
• 'Cloakroom' is **a room in a public building where outdoor clothes or luggage may be left**.
 
 
• Example: *He deposited his overcoat in the **cloakroom***.
 
 
 
• 'Dormitory' is **a large bedroom for a number of people in a school or institution**.
 
 
• Example: *We were housed student-wise in **dormitory** rooms*.
 
 
 
• 'Observatory' is **a room or building housing an astronomical telescope or other scientific equipment for the study of natural phenomena**.
 
 
• Example: *The Royal Greenwich **Observatory** was founded to observe and catalog the stars*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.*

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words.**

A disease that is found in a particular place and is difficult to get rid of.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Endemic'.

***__Key Points__**

 
• Let us explore the given options:-

 
 
• 'Chronic' is **(of an illness) persisting for a long time or constantly recurring**.

 
 
• Example: *If left untreated the condition may become **chronic***.
 
 
 
• 'Pandemic' is **(of a disease) prevalent over a whole country or the world**.
 
 
• Example: *All countries should immediately activate their **pandemic** preparedness plans*.
 
 
 
• 'Infection' is **the process of infecting or the state of being infected**.
 
 
• Example: *She has got an ear **infection***.
 
 
 
• 'Endemic' is **(of a disease or condition) regularly found among particular people or in a certain area**.
 
 
• Example: *Chest disease is **endemic** among miners in this area*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.*

questions.question:
**Directions: Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

The diagrams should be draw and label neatly.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'draw and label'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the use of the **base form of the verb ''draw and label''** is **incorrect**.
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice with the modal verb 'should'**.
 
• The **basic pattern** we use here for **passive modal** is **modal (here, should) + be + past participle (V3)**.
 
• Therefore, the **past participle form of the verb ''drawn and labeled''** should be used **in place of** the **base form of the verb ''draw and label''**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Correct Sentence:** *The diagrams should be **drawn and labeled** neatly*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Mother said to Ravi, “Get me the newspaper.”

options.text: Mother said Ravi to get me the newspaper.
Mother told Ravi to get her the newspaper.
Mother asks Ravi to get her the newspaper.
Mother said to Ravi to got her the newspaper.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Mother told Ravi to get her the newspaper**.

__
 
• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or ____converting direct speech into indirect speech__:​
 __
 
• The commas and inverted commas are removed and "said to'' is changed into 'told'.
 
• The first-person pronoun 'me' should be replaced by the third-person pronoun 'her'.
 
• If in a direct speech, the **words within the quotation mark talk of universal truth or habitual action** then **do not change the tense of reported speech in the indirect speech** sentence.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes into Indirect speech:-

• The **given sentence** is a **direct speech**.
 
• The **basic rules** for changing or __**__converting direct speech into indirect speech__:**
 
 
• The **commas, inverted commas** and the **question mark** are **removed **and **'said to'** is replaced by **'asked'**.
 
• The second-person pronoun '**you'** is **replaced by** the third-person pronoun '**he**'.
 
• The **present continuous tense** format **'Subject + are + V₁ (take) + ing + Object' **will be changed into the **past continuous tense format 'Subject + was + V₁ (take) + ing + Object'.**
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87c1a28e731fadd9279228c1cea2f8e988a3f790bf9ccc89c9b0f02c423b1609.png]

 **Direct Speech**

questions.question:
**Directions: Given below are four sentences that are jumbled. Pick the option that gives the correct order.**

A. Sew the two rectangular pieces together all the way to make a double layer.

B. Finally, sew the elastic straps to the mask along the long edges.

C. Now make three evenly spaced pleats in the sewn rectangles.

D. In order to make a face mask, take 2 rectangular pieces of cotton fabric that measure about 7 inches by 9 inches.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'DACB'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence 'D' is independent of any other sentences as it is giving general information about "how to make a face mask". Hence, 'D' is the first part.
 
• The "**two rectangular pieces**" mentioned in the sentence 'A' refers back to the "two rectangular pieces'' mentioned in the sentence 'D'. Hence, 'A' follows 'D'.
 
• The "sewn rectangles" mentioned in the sentence 'C' is linked with the phrase "**Sew the two rectangular pieces**" mentioned in the sentence 'A'. Hence, 'C' follows 'A'.
 
• The sentence 'B' is the concluding sentence. Hence, 'B' is the last sentence.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *In order to make a face mask, take 2 rectangular pieces of cotton fabric that measure about 7 inches by 9 inches. Sew the two rectangular pieces together all the way to make a double layer. Now make three evenly spaced pleats in the sewn rectangles. Finally, sew the elastic straps to the mask along the long edges.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__***

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

questions.question: **Select the most appropriate word to fill in blank no. 1.**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'in'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate word **to be** filled in the blank **should be** 'in'**.
 
• The preposition 'in' is used **for expressing the situation of something that is or appears to be enclosed or surrounded by something else**.
 
• The preposition 'in' is a preposition of place that is used to discuss an enclosed space (here, the mall).
 
• A preposition of place is a preposition that is used to refer to a place where something or someone (here, expensive outlets) is located (in the mall).

 ​

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The preposition 'with' means accompanied by (another person or thing).
